name: All Steel Inc
old_description: All Steel Inc. is a Leading Provider of Metal Roofing Systems and Building Supplies
about:
All Steel Inc. operates two manufacturing facilities in Fairbanks and Wasilla, Alaska. The company was founded in 1998 as a family-owned business by Michael P. Kralman and his mother, Sandra M. Kralman.

The company manufactures metal roofing systems, metal wall panels, and a range of light gauge steel components including roofing, trim flashings, soffit, studs, track, and complete steel buildings. It also produces gutters, downspouts, elbows, and distributes IKO architectural and 3-tab roofing shingles. A custom roll forming machine was built in-house for a complex commercial project.

All Steel serves commercial and residential contractors across Alaska. Notable projects include fabricating up to 46 cold-formed steel trusses per week for Eielson Air Force Base and supplying custom-colored flashings and curved framing for the Chief Andrew Isaac Clinic. The company also supports general building and renovation projects throughout the state.

The founders started the business to address Alaska's short summer construction season, which makes ordering from out-of-state suppliers impractical. They emphasize quick turnaround, maintaining stock on hand, and a local workforce that understands the region's environmental extremes. The family-owned structure and in-house manufacturing capability allow them to control quality and respond to custom requirements.
